sentences.text:
----Respondents
For Petitioner(s) : None Present
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mukesh Trivedi, Pp
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Garg
Order 21/04/2023

The instant misc. petition has been filed by the petitioner for quashing the FIR No.373/2022, Police Station Goluwala, District Hanumangarh for offences under Sections 363 &
366 of IPC.

Learned Public Prosecutor has submitted a report dated 20.04.2023 received Police Station Goluwala, District Hanumangarh wherein it has been mentioned that after investigation, offences under Sections 354(D), 376(2)(N) of IPC, Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act and Sections 3(1)(W),
3(2)(Va) & 3(2)(V) of SC/ST Act has been added against the petitioner and he has already been arrested in this case.
The said report is hereby taken on record.

[2023/RJJD/011471] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-194/2023] In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances,
the present misc. petition has become infructuous and dismissed accordingly.
Stay application also stands dismissed.
(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 15-raksha/-
